doctrine: SNIPED_Chat_Prompts_Reference is an operational template library for two distinct project contexts: the SNIPED Media work (aesthetic/art/content execution) and SNIPED Media Strategic (thinking/planning/analysis). Seven core chats govern the work: (1) Aesthetic Audit (reference only, skip), (2) Art Series The (reference only, skip), (3) Re-Edit Workflow (triage/operations/quality control/output tracking for archive re-editing), (4) Studying [Photographer] (4-step deep study: distinctive thread, 8-criteria audit on 3-5 frames, scoring profile synthesis, comparison-to-self learning), (5) Art Series Entry [N] (5-section production plan: original breakdown, spirit-recreation balance, production specifics, post format/caption, timeline), (6) Caption Help (3-length-option caption generation with voice rules: no buzzwords/hashtags/motivational closers/em-dashes), (7) Random Question (throwaway, 1-3 messages). Strategic chats: (1) Site Rebuild Notes (running notes container for snipedmedia.com rebuild prep, opens now, 3-4 weeks), (2) IG Content Calendar [Month] (30-day calendar, 3 posts/week mix, posting cadence, monthly arc, caption direction), (3) Site Build (opens week 4+, phases: strategic decisions / page redesign / build sequencing), (4) Conversation Signals (capture real-world input from operators, file under headings, identify patterns at 3+ signal threshold), (5) Monthly Retrospective (pattern/aesthetic/energy/priority check, honest operator-grade voice), (6) Update Handoff (materialize changes to SNIPED_Session_Handoff doc). Architecture assumes project knowledge contains: Aesthetic_Statement_v1, Art_Series_The.md, SNIPED_Session_Handoff.docx, 5 Stacks (Doctrine/Install/Outbound/Copywriting/Platform). Immediate action: open Conversation Signals (Strategic), Site Rebuild Notes (Strategic), Studying Richard Avedon today. 9-photographer study order locked: Avedon, Eggleston, Leibovitz, Shore, Herzog, Frank, Meyerowitz, Iturbide, Haas. Art series outputs replace monthly in project knowledge. Two filename changes from original spec: Art_Series_The_12.md is now Art_Series_The.md.

notes: This is the operational nerve center for SNIPED's work and strategic thinking. It is a template reference, not a narrative; copy-paste structure with variable swaps is the intended use. The doc assumes full project knowledge context (Aesthetic_Statement, Art_Series, Stacks, Session Handoff); the prompts only make sense paired with those assets. No boilerplate, no fluff, no UI nav. Pure operational structure. The 'Right Now' section (three chats to open today) is time-bound to the original document creation; the user will have advanced this timeline, so the date signal is stale, but the structure remains permanent. The 9-photographer study order is locked and non-negotiable per the spec. Voice rules (no em-dashes, no buzzwords, no hashtag spam, no motivational closers) appear in multiple chats; treat as a standing operating order, not a per-chat reminder.
